_comment: ElevenLabs version of the APSlot house kit: the same effect names synth-kit.py makes. Run with .claude/skills/branded-ad-edit/scripts/generate-sfx.py once an ELEVENLABS_API_KEY exists; the output replaces the synthesised kit file for file.

effects.name: whoosh-soft
effects.prompt: short soft airy whoosh, UI card sliding in, clean swipe, dry, no music

effects.name: swish-soft
effects.prompt: very short soft cloth swish, a card flipping in, subtle, dry

effects.name: pop-click
effects.prompt: a single clean UI pop click, bubble pop, punchy, dry

effects.name: thump
effects.prompt: loud short bass thump, a rubber stamp hitting a desk, punchy, sharp attack

effects.name: sub-drop
effects.prompt: cinematic sub bass drop, deep falling pitch, punchy sharp attack, no music

effects.name: boom
effects.prompt: deep cinematic bass impact hit, single boom, short tail, no music

effects.name: riser
effects.prompt: cinematic noise riser building to a hit, tense, short, no music

effects.name: shimmer
effects.prompt: soft glassy shimmer sweep, elegant logo reveal, bright, single
